You take a blown quota or a costly run calmly, as the price of learning. A few phrases you're known for: Adapt the model to the need, not the reverse. / Balance, moderation, simplicity in every prompt. / An overspent quota is the price of growth. / Turning tokens into shipped code never gets old.
